Biyang Biyang Tonefancier series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Biyang DS-7 Distortion Published on October 10, 2007 Biyang Tonefancier series distortion pedal Information Biyang Tonefancier series effects,which have used the high-class handwork effects as standard, with a high cost in adopting a lot of high-quality and well-known HI-FI audio parts and combined with classic circuits and good internal structure, have reached a very high quality level! DS-7 supply 3 kind of distortion tones: The NORMAL mode keeps the classic distortion tone, a saturated tone, a moderate distortion tone. tune on the BRIGHT model for brightness enhancement,supply the almost same broad and smooth tone as the same like the tube. it has good performance in terms of both dynamic and detailed tone. WARM mode is the warmly tone, high gain tone, longer delay.
